what: BBVA is a Spanish bank whose most profitable business is in Mexico, where it is the largest bank. It also operates in Spain, Turkey and South America.
customers: Households and businesses in Mexico, Spain, Turkey and South America.
money: Garanti BBVA and banks in Colombia, Peru, Argentina
moat: Market leadership in Mexico and one of the more advanced digital banking operations in Europe.
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 18%, high for a European bank
Mexican operations earn returns well above its European business
A dividend yield around 4.5% with large buybacks on top
watch: Mexican net interest income and Spanish loan growth.
